description: Best DeFi yields (APY) across lending/liquidity pools, highest first, source DefiLlama. Optional parameters: ?chain=<slug> (e.g. base), ?min_tvl=<usd> (minimum pool TVL), ?limit=<n> (default 20, max 100). Costs $0.05 via x402 (USDC).

chain.description: Filter by chain name (e.g. base, ethereum). Optional.

limit.description: Number of pools to return (1-100, default 20).

min_tvl.description: Minimum pool TVL in USD. Optional.

name: get_api_defi_yields
